video_title: Post Game Press Conference l Jarrett Jack l Pistons vs Raptors I 10.16.26

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Jack
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Jack on the Pistons' young group and their performance
quotes.excerpt: our young group that last group coming in playing Pistons basketball after sitting over there for quite some time
quotes.quote: Our young group, that last group coming in, playing Pistons basketball after sitting over there for quite some time was very impressive. Obviously, Abuka was able to show off some of his ability to be creative off the bounce and get us going a bit, but we know the start of the game and for three quarters almost, we were a tad bit sluggish and couldn't seem to get our rhythm in sync. For us, we know we still have a long ways of having a consistent approach, especially from our starting group, but overall, we came out and got the win and was able to close out this preseason on a good note.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Jack says the Pistons young group provided a spark off the bench tonight, noting that while the starters were sluggish, the reserves were impressive in closing out the preseason with a win.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Jack
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Jack on the team's self-accountability during halftime
quotes.excerpt: a lot of the talk during halftime was we know we're better than this
quotes.quote: A lot of the talk during halftime was we know we're better than this. This is not our standard. So before we go out and face any of our opponents, what we do and what we bring, that's part of our controllables, is something we had at the forefront, and glad to see our guys took on the challenge.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Jack says the halftime message for the Pistons was simple: we know we are better than this. He credited the players for taking on the challenge to improve their play in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Jack
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Jack on the team's depth and player opportunities
quotes.excerpt: we're constantly saying everybody's kind of showcasing their ability for their opportunity
quotes.quote: We're constantly saying everybody's showcasing their ability for their opportunity. Luckily for me, I don't have to make those decisions, but that's one of the strengths of our team, our depth, being able to rely and count on a number of guys given different circumstances. And I think our guys have a respect level for each other's talents in the locker room, and they understand that anyone could get called on. It's not because you're not playing well, it can just be a different look and different skill set. So for us, we just use it to our advantage, understanding that maybe some of the stints that the other teams play won't be as long, but we play ours long, fast, and fierce and physical.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Jack on the Pistons depth: We play long, fast, and fierce. He says the team understands that rotations may change based on matchups, but the focus remains on playing physical basketball.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Jack
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Jack on Cade Cunningham's three-point shooting improvement
quotes.excerpt: that was something that was really concentrated this summer coming back into this year
quotes.quote: That was something that was really concentrated this summer coming back into this year, whether it's off the bounce or being able to play with other guys that can create offense. He can get some easy walk-in catch-and-shoot opportunities, and he's done a good job of it, being diligent and consistent in his work, preparation, and his mechanics, and so far it's paying dividends and we hope for it to stay trending in that direction.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Jack says Cade Cunningham has been diligent with his mechanics this summer, and his improved three-point shooting is already paying dividends for the Pistons offense.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Jack
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Jack on Cade Cunningham's development and game shape
quotes.excerpt: we're still rounding him into game shape. I think that's probably the biggest marker for us
quotes.quote: He looked really fluid, fast, athletic. We're still rounding him into game shape. I think that's probably the biggest marker for us in this whole thing as we approach Tuesday. Getting him comfortable with a few tweaks we put in our offense, but for the most part, we just want Cade to be that dominant physical presence he's always been, connecting the floor offensively and defensively for us.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Jack says Cade Cunningham is still rounding into game shape as the regular season approaches, but the team wants him to be the dominant physical presence he has always been.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Jack
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Jack on Abuka's poise and basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: at his age, it seems like very few things can shake him
quotes.quote: He has a very even-keeled personality about him on his own, and that's kind of priceless when you translate it in the game situations. He doesn't get rattled, doesn't get too high or too low. He's a workhorse. We watch a ton of film, and he's able to absorb and apply a lot of different things on the fly. So what he was able to map out tonight, being able to get into the paint, whether to score or be able to read for kick-outs, those are things that he naturally possesses, but with the short time we've been together, he's picked up things really quickly and been able to showcase a lot of the reason why he's a Detroit Piston.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Jack praises Abuka for his poise and basketball IQ, noting that he does not get rattled and has been able to apply film study to game situations very quickly.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Jack
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Jack on Elijah's fit with the team's identity
quotes.excerpt: the first time we got to see Hark in our building this summer, all of us looked at each other and said he fits
quotes.quote: The first time we got to see Hark in our building this summer, all of us looked at each other and said he fits. He fits us, our identity, who we are, what we do, physical, disruptive, somebody who wants to take on the challenge, workhorse as well. And then on top of all those great intangibles, he listens. Always asking questions, always wants to figure out and understand how he can be better in our system. Selfless. To sit over there for an hour and then to come in with that non-stop presence, non-stop energy, that's something we look for for our young guys to help build out and round out our program.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Jack says Elijah fits the Pistons identity perfectly, describing him as a selfless, physical, and disruptive player who is always looking for ways to improve in the system.
